rationale: The Blender compatibility profile is a deterministic compatibility, safety and interchange contract. It does not rank candidates, select providers or models, grant permissions, choose execution resources, or make runtime promotion decisions. Existing Blender/Bforartists compatibility invariants, HRB, Hardware Safety Envelope, Model Router, Render Fabric, Reuse Discovery and human-controlled creative authorities remain authoritative, so Decision Fabric must not introduce a parallel choice layer.
